method: Within-year z-score for stage2-6 date; equal average of same-bird crossyear standardized residual pair-products across 30 repeated birds. Shuffle entire five-stage date vector among fixed bird-year identity slots within each year, 10k independent Monte Carlo draws, keeping within-year data and missingness. This is a post-result exploratory test.
randomization: Independent JS LCG seeded 20261008; cross-validation via GitHub Python random.Random in dedicated CI still pending
limitations: Spring departure timing repeatability already well known: Franklin et al 2022 meta-analysis 47 species mean 0.414; Asian houbara environmental cue repeatability demonstrated 2021.
Bird ID signature may reflect site/route/social group/sex/condition etc, not a fixed individual timing mechanism.
Stage5 within-year residual persistence is distinct from active environmental feedback, direct cue use or adaptive fitness.
Pairwise Pearson uses 97 nonindependent same-bird pairs; individual-equal standardized product and permutation use 30 independent bird-level repeated units but share annual weather.
Stage5 vs stage3 superiority is not established by this exploratory paired contrast.
5 stages inspected before permutation audit; p values are postselection exploratory and not a new preregistered claim.
No behavioral manipulation, source cue, route-specific climate, physical actuator capacity, or breeding outcome used.
